name: Witness Of The Holy Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals the Holy Spirit as the divine witness to Christ’s identity and mission, descending visibly like a dove upon Jesus and affirming Him as God's beloved Son (Luke 3:22; John 1:32-33). The Spirit, sent from the Father as the Spirit of truth, testifies of Christ and empowers the faithful preaching of the gospel (John 15:26). Furthermore, God has exalted Christ as Prince and Saviour to grant repentance and forgiveness, underscoring the Spirit’s role in redemption and sanctification (Acts 5:31). These verses collectively highlight the Holy Spirit’s essential witness to Christ’s person and work, confirming the gospel message and enabling believers to embrace salvation.
